title: Orka.ai RAG retrieval paraphrase evaluation
description: Offline retrieval-only evaluation. Each paraphrase is mapped to the SQL example expected to support it. No Groq or Langfuse calls are made.

groups.target_source: Which customers have at least one cancelled order?
variants: Find customers who have at least one cancelled order.
List customers associated with orders marked Cancelled.
Who placed at least one cancelled order?

groups.target_source: Show distinct products included in each order.
variants: Show distinct products included in each order.
Count unique products for every order.
For each order, how many different products were included?
Give the number of distinct product IDs per order.

groups.target_source: What is the total revenue for each product category?
variants: Which product category has the highest total revenue?
Rank product categories by total sales value.
Which category generated the most revenue?
Calculate sales revenue for each product category and identify the highest.
